cards.title: Handling childhood sexual abuse in families
cards.body: Help victims feel safe to share at their own pace and consider any ongoing danger to younger family members. Professional support is crucial for processing trauma and protecting children.

cards.title: Parenting through empty nest transition
cards.body: Sending your first child to university triggers unexpected grief, despite knowing intellectually it's a natural life stage. The emotional reality often surprises parents unprepared for this major shift.

cards.title: Second baby parenting: what you forget
cards.body: New parents with a second child often realize they've forgotten crucial details about feeding, teething, and sleep patterns from their first. Family support and patience help navigate these rediscovered challenges.

cards.title: Taking toddlers to music festivals
cards.body: Families with young children can enhance the festival experience rather than diminish it. Parenting twins at raves offers unexpected joys and memorable moments.

cards.title: Saving your marriage for the kids' sake
cards.body: Some parents choose a middle path between staying and leaving for their children's benefit, though this isn't healthy or feasible for all families. Professional guidance helps determine if this approach works for your situation.

cards.title: Raising confident, independent children
cards.body: True independence develops through real decisions, real mistakes, and self-directed problem-solving experiences. Parents must allow children to learn from genuine consequences.

cards.title: Postpartum pet aversion explained
cards.body: Some new mothers experience sudden overwhelming feelings toward beloved pets after pregnancy, causing shame and confusion. Understanding this postpartum condition helps families seek appropriate support.

cards.title: Climate change and childhood abuse risk
cards.body: Extreme heat increases family stress and may elevate risks of child maltreatment beyond physical health impacts. Understanding this connection helps communities prepare protective resources.

cards.title: Childhood trauma's effects on adult health
cards.body: Chronic pain and illness in adults often stem from unprocessed childhood trauma or painful events. Trauma-informed therapy can address these root causes.
